profile.description: PICC Property and Casualty Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in property and casualty insurance business in People’s Republic of China. It operates through six segments: motor vehicle, accidental injury and health, agriculture, Liability, Commercial Property, and Other. The company offers motor vehicle, commercial property, cargo, liability, accidental injury, short-term health, agriculture, credit, surety, household property, marine hull, and other insurance products. It also provides reinsurance, investment and funds application, insurance agency services, training services, IT services, and property management services, etc. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Beijing, China. PICC Property and Casualty Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of The People’s Insurance Company (Group) of China Limited.
